title: Facets
description: Counts and ranges across the full matching inventory, before pagination. Shared by inventory.facets and optional search-response facets on every binding. Omitted facets are unavailable; zero counts describe known empty buckets. Feature counts use verified present equipment only.

term_facet.description: A term facet: each entry pairs a distinct field value with the count of matching vehicles.

value.description: A distinct value observed for this field across the matching set (e.g. a make, model, year or DC fast-charge boolean).

count.description: Number of matching vehicles carrying this value.

range_facet.description: A numeric range facet: the observed min and max for a field across the matching set.

min.description: Lowest observed value for this field across the matching set.

max.description: Highest observed value for this field across the matching set.

dc_fast_charge.description: DC-fast-charge support facets (true/false counts), matching `Vehicle.dc_fast_charge` and `filters.dc_fast_charge`.

charge_ports.description: EV charge/plug connector facets (e.g. `nacs`, `ccs`, `j1772`), matching `Vehicle.charge_port` and `filters.charge_port`.

bodies.description: Body-style / segment facets, matching the `body` field on Vehicle and `filters.body` on InventorySearchRequest. Covers car body styles (e.g. 'sedan', 'suv') and motorcycle segments (e.g. 'cruiser', 'touring') alike.

rooftops.description: Rooftop facets — vehicle counts per dealership location, matching `Vehicle.rooftop` and `filters.rooftops`.

price_range.description: Observed minimum and maximum of authoritative Vehicle.price values. Vehicles without `price` do not contribute; omit `price_range` when no matching vehicle has `price`.

displacement_cc_range.description: Engine-displacement range in cc across the matching set, matching `Vehicle.displacement_cc` and `filters.displacement_cc_min` / `filters.displacement_cc_max`.

electric_range_mi_range.description: Electric-range span in miles across the matching set, matching `Vehicle.electric_range_mi` and `filters.electric_range_mi_min` / `filters.electric_range_mi_max`.

features.description: Advertised feature vocabulary and verified present counts. A code has one meaning across the deployment; unknown codes return UNSUPPORTED_FILTER. Counts exclude absent and unknown equipment.
